questions.qtext: Efflorescence in saline soils occurs primarily due to

options.text: Downward percolation of water rich in salts into the groundwater table
Absorption of carbon dioxide by the soil surface leading to salt precipitation
Upward movement of water from the water table carrying dissolved salts, followed by evaporation at the surface
Flow of water from inside the roots into the soil by osmosis

questions.solution:
(c)
Downward percolation of water through the soil containing salts is called leaching. The phenomenon
of salts coming up in solution and forming a thin crust on the surface after evaporation of water
is called effloresence.
